jobs.title: Tampere University Scholarships 2027 (Finland)

jobs.title: Harvey Mudd College (USA)
jobs.description: Merit award for first-year entrants. Listed as open; no deadline shown, check the page.

jobs.title: Gates Cambridge Scholarship (University of Cambridge, UK)
jobs.description: Postgraduate (PhD, MLitt, some 1-year masters). Full cost: fees, stipend, airfare, visa. Non-UK citizens apply in Round 2, due 8 Dec 2026 or 6 Jan 2027 by course. Open to Ugandans.

jobs.title: Clarendon Scholarships (University of Oxford, UK)
jobs.description: Master's and DPhil. Full fees plus living grant. No separate form: apply for the course by the Dec 2026 or Jan 2027 deadline. All nationalities; third-party page, confirm on official site.

jobs.title: NL High Potential Scholarship (Maastricht University, Netherlands)
jobs.description: Full-time master's from Sept 2027. About EUR 36,000 for tuition, living costs and insurance. Scholarship deadline 1 Feb 2027; admission deadline Dec 2026. Non-EU, under 35, GPA 7.5/10+; confirm dates on official site.

jobs.title: Radboud Scholarship Programme (Radboud University, Netherlands)
jobs.description: English-taught master's. Partial award cutting tuition to EUR 2,771/yr and covering visa and insurance. Deadline 31 Jan 2027, with programme admission required. Non-EU students such as Ugandans can apply; confirm on official site.

jobs.title: KTH Scholarships (KTH Royal Institute of Technology, Sweden)
jobs.description: Master's tuition waiver (living costs not covered) for fee-paying non-EU/EEA citizens, merit-based. Deadline 15 Jan 2027 for an Aug 2027 start. Ugandans eligible; third-party page, confirm on official site.

jobs.title: Justus & Louise van Effen Excellence Scholarships (TU Delft, Netherlands)
jobs.description: Two-year MSc. Full tuition plus a living-cost contribution. Deadline 1 Dec 2026 for Sept 2027, with the MSc application and 2 references. Top 10% of graduates; confirm on official site.

jobs.title: Erasmus Mundus Joint Master's Scholarships (European Union)
jobs.description: Master's worldwide. Offered by many consortia; most accept applications from October to January. Open to Ugandans. Dates and funding vary by programme, so confirm on each consortium site.

jobs.title: Mastercard Foundation Scholars Program at Ashesi University (Ghana)
jobs.description: Undergraduate. Covers tuition, room and board, learning resources. Ongoing, allocated via Ashesi's general application. Needs African citizenship, financial need and leadership. Confirm the deadline on the Ashesi site.

jobs.title: Hungary (via Ministry of Education)
jobs.description: Undergraduate places via the Ugandan Ministry of Education. Last call was posted Oct 2025; watch this page for the 2027/28 advert.

jobs.title: Undergraduate (via Ministry of Education)
jobs.description: Undergraduate application form issued via the Ministry. Last advert posted Dec 2025 (2026/27); watch the Ministry page for the next one.

jobs.title: Makerere University
jobs.description: 245 undergraduate awards in the 2026/27 call, closed 5 Jun 2026. Needs a Makerere private-scheme admission application. Watch for next intake.

jobs.title: Chevening Scholarships (UK Government)
jobs.description: Fully funded master's in the UK. The 2027/28 round is closed for Uganda; the next round normally opens around August and closes in October. Ugandan citizens eligible; check criteria on the official site.

jobs.title: Rhodes Scholarship (University of Oxford, UK)
jobs.description: Postgraduate at Oxford. Fully funded: fees, stipend, flights, visa costs. Applications are closed and reopen in 2027 for 2028 entry. Confirm Uganda's constituency and the deadline on the Trust site.

jobs.title: Mandela Rhodes Scholarship (South Africa)
jobs.description: Honours or Master's at a South African university for African leaders aged 19-29. Covers tuition, accommodation, meals, leadership training. Next round reportedly opens Mar 2027 (third-party listing); confirm on official site.

jobs.title: Aga Khan Foundation International Scholarship Programme (Switzerland)
jobs.description: Postgraduate (Master's, PhD first 2 years). 50% grant, 50% loan, for students with financial need. 2026-27 cycle closed; next opens early 2027. Uganda is a listed country.

jobs.title: Turkiye Scholarships / Turkiye Burslari (Turkiye)
jobs.description: Bachelor's, master's and PhD. Covers tuition, housing, monthly stipend, insurance, language course, one flight. General application usually 10 Jan to 20 Feb. Confirm the 2027 dates on the official calendar.

jobs.title: Fulbright Foreign Student Program, Uganda (United States)
jobs.description: Master's study in the US, fully funded up to 2 years. Ugandan citizens only, via US Embassy Kampala. Last call closed 21 Mar 2026; expect a similar early-year window. Third-party listing, confirm on official site.

jobs.title: Commonwealth Scholarships for Ugandans (UK, via Ministry of Education)
jobs.description: Master's and PhD in the UK. The 2027/28 Uganda call (20 Master's, 15 PhD slots) closed 17 Sep 2026. Next call likely Aug-Sep 2027; Master's needs CGPA 3.60+ and 2 years' work. Confirm on CSC and Ministry sites.

jobs.title: Ireland Fellows Programme, Africa (Ireland)
jobs.description: Master's in Ireland for Ugandans and Rwandans; 16 fully funded awards a year. 2027/28 window was 29 Jun to 26 Jul 2026. Needs 2:1 or GPA 3.7+, 2+ years' experience, no prior overseas study. Expect a similar window mid-2027.

jobs.title: Australia Awards Scholarships in Africa (Australia)
jobs.description: Master's for eligible African candidates in priority fields (climate action, food security, mining). Site says the next round opens 1 Feb 2027. Confirm Uganda's eligibility on the official site.

jobs.title: Japanese Government (MEXT) Scholarships (Japan, via Ministry of Education)
jobs.description: Uganda's Ministry of Education posted MEXT calls in May 2026. Applications go through the Ministry and the Japanese embassy. Expect a similar window around May 2027; read the advert PDFs for eligibility.

jobs.title: HESFB Student Loan Scheme (Government of Uganda)
jobs.description: Government tuition loans for Ugandan undergraduate and diploma students at recognised institutions. 2025/26 call closed 31 Jul 2025; calls normally run June-July. Confirm the current call on the HESFB site.

jobs.title: Mastercard Foundation Scholarship at Cambridge (University of Cambridge, UK)
jobs.description: One-year master's on climate resilience and sustainability for African citizens resident in Africa. Covers tuition and monthly allowance. Expect 2027/28 to open around autumn 2026. Confirm on the programme site.
